shifts.summary: Shift 1 on 2026-10-16 was reported as Easy to Moderate by candidates. Most reports did not specify overall difficulty or good attempts, but one source gave 75-80 overall good attempts. Questions covered general awareness, reasoning, quantitative aptitude, and English. Several GA questions repeated across sources, including the Forest Man of India and 1991 economic reforms. Some sources included answer keys alongside the questions.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Topics included active-passive voice, idioms, one-word substitution, and synonyms. Odd one out questions on legislative bodies were also reported.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Heavy coverage of current affairs, constitutional law, and static GK. Repeated themes included BNS section 103, MC Mary Kom, Neolithic sites, and 1991 reforms.

topics.topic: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan 2.0

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Questions focused on ratio and LCM, simple interest, and divisibility. One question involved finding values for divisibility by 72.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Covered active voice, misspelled words, idiom meanings, synonyms, and word meanings. Spelling questions appeared frequently.

asked.q: Which among the following is known as the Forest Man of India?
Find the odd one out among the four options: Supreme Court, Vidhan Sabha, Rajya Sabha, Lok Sabha
After the 1991 economic reforms, in which sector did the Indian economy experience the most significant positive impact?
If laptop sales need to be increased in a market, which business or economic strategy would be most effective?
In which city of India was the 2025 Men's Hockey Asia Cup held?
If a six-digit number 45x72y is completely divisible by 72, what is the value of x + y?
What is the name of the famous Indian boxer who made history by winning the World Boxing Championship a record six times?
Which of the following archaeological sites is famous for Neolithic sites excavated in the state of Tamil Nadu?
Which two districts of West Bengal are known as the major maize production producing region?
What is the correct meaning of the English idiom 'Chips on One Shoulder'?
Which of the following words is misspelt?
Which offense is specifically addressed under section 103 of the BNS in relation to mob lynching?
Which country hosted the 2025 IC Women's Cricket World Cup?
Which Indian boxer holds the record for winning six world boxing championship titles?

observations: Multiple sources repeated similar GA questions, indicating topic emphasis.
Answer keys were provided in some video reports alongside questions.
English section had a high number of spelling and idiom questions.
Quantitative aptitude focused on basic arithmetic and divisibility rules.
disagreements: Some sources listed the 2025 Men's Hockey Asia Cup in Rajgir, while others asked without specifying the city.
Spelling questions had conflicting correct answers across sources (sycophant vs positive vs quicken).
Neolithic site questions varied between Paiyampalli and Burzahom as answers.
Economic reforms impact questions gave different sector answers (international trade vs import of cheap goods).

shifts.summary: Shift 2 was reported as Moderate to Difficult overall, with candidates attempting 65-73 questions well. General Awareness and Quantitative Aptitude were the toughest sections, while Reasoning and English were comparatively easier. Most reports noted a focus on fixed topics in GA, with repeated questions on constitutional articles, economic reforms, and government schemes. Quantitative Aptitude posed timing challenges, especially in Data Interpretation and Trigonometry.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Reported as doable with no major timing issues. Candidates said it could be finished within 15 minutes.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Reported as the most challenging section. Candidates said it stuck to 4-5 fixed topics, with repeated questions on constitutional articles, economic reforms, and government schemes.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Reported as very difficult with major timing issues. Candidates said only 18-19 questions were attempted, with struggles in Trigonometry and Data Interpretation being skipped entirely.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Reported as doable but lengthy and time-consuming. Candidates said it was easier compared to other sections.

asked.q: Dr. Bhim Singh Bhavesh, awarded Padma Shri in 2025 for social work, belongs to which state? (Bihar)
Which statement best describes the structural change in Indian economy as a major impact of 1991 economic reforms? (Expansion of industrial and service sectors, decline in agriculture's GDP share)
Before appointing a judge to Supreme Court or High Court, whose advice is important for the President? (Chief Justice of India and collegium)
By what name is the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution popularly known? (Anti-defection law)
Meaning of idiom: 'The famous politician lost the election after the media revealed skeletons in his closet.' (Embarrassing or shocking secret from the past)
Government of India's MISHTI scheme is mainly related to? (Conservation and plantation of mangrove forests along the coastline)
Under Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Yojana, how much daily stipend is given to a trainee or artisan during skill enhancement training? (₹500 per day)
If a bus is moving at steady speed and driver applies sudden brakes, what happens to person sitting in bus? (Feels jerk forward, Newton's first law)
If a person released after serving 4-year sentence commits offense again, what principle applies to sentencing? (Habitual offender, harsher sentence)
In which Olympic Games did India win total of seven medals for most successful performance? (2020 Tokyo Olympics)
Meghalaya Plateau, including Garo, Khasi, Jaintia hills, is extended part of which geographical division? (Peninsular Plateau)
According to World Happiness Report 2026, how many countries recorded significant improvement in happiness rankings? (79 countries)
Under Article 127 of Indian Constitution, whose prior consent does Chief Justice of India require for appointment of ad hoc judge in Supreme Court? (President of India)
Under which political leader's regime was the world's first five-year plan initiated? (Joseph Stalin)

observations: General Awareness had repeated questions on constitutional articles, economic reforms, and government schemes across shifts.
Quantitative Aptitude was the most challenging section with timing issues, especially in Data Interpretation and Trigonometry.
Reasoning was reported as the easiest section, doable within 15 minutes without timing pressure.
English section was considered lengthy but manageable, with a focus on error spotting and idioms.
disagreements: 4 reports called Quant difficult to very difficult, while 1 report called it moderate.
3 reports called GA difficult, while 1 report called it easy.
2 reports called English moderate to difficult, while 2 reports called it easy.
2 reports called overall moderate to difficult, while 2 reports called it moderate or easy to moderate.

Students who practiced previous years' papers performed well.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 16 October 2026 has been analysed based on candidate feedback and reported summaries. Shift 1 was described as Easy to Moderate, while Shift 2 was reported as Moderate to Difficult. Shift 3 has only a partial review available, so more evidence is needed before drawing firm conclusions. The figures mentioned are unofficial, and SSC normalises scores across shifts. No reliable data on good attempts is available for Shift 3.

faqs.q: What was the difficulty level of SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 Shift 1 on 16 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 1 on 16 October 2026 was reported as Easy to Moderate by most candidates. Questions were asked from general awareness, reasoning, quantitative aptitude, and English.

faqs.q: What was the difficulty level of SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 Shift 2 on 16 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 2 on 16 October 2026 was reported as Moderate to Difficult. General Awareness and Quantitative Aptitude were the toughest sections, while Reasoning and English were comparatively easier.

faqs.q: What was the difficulty level of SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 Shift 3 on 16 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 3 on 16 October 2026 has only a partial review published. Reasoning and English were on the easier side, while GA and Quant were Moderate. More evidence is needed for a complete analysis.

faqs.q: How many good attempts were reported for SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 on 16 October 2026?
faqs.a: For Shift 1 on 16 October 2026, one source reported 75-80 overall good attempts. For Shift 2, candidates attempted 65-73 questions well. Good attempts for Shift 3 are not reliably reported.

faqs.q: Were there any repeated questions in SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 on 16 October 2026?
faqs.a: Yes, several GA questions were repeated across sources for 16 October 2026, including the Forest Man of India and 1991 economic reforms. Shift 2 also noted repeated questions on constitutional articles, economic reforms, and government schemes.
